Author: xRopers
Name: TargetHighlight
Punchline: Recolour or remove the flash when you target something.
Description:
Changes the brightness flash the game plays on a character or NPC model when you target it. Turn it off, keep the game's flash, or replace it with your own colour, intensity and fade, with an option to hold the colour for as long as the object stays targeted.

This changes the target flash, not the coloured outline highlight. Purely cosmetic and client-side.

Commands: /targethighlight (settings), /targethighlight none|default|custom|preview

The plugin icon was created with AI assistance.
